Pecan cheddar cheese balls on toothpicks
everything in neat rows, the way Raymond likes it

Bite-size balls of sharp cheddar, cream cheese, spring onion and Worcestershire rolled in toasted pecans, each speared on a toothpick and lined up in rows. Beat 250g softened cream cheese with 200g finely grated vintage cheddar, 2 finely chopped spring onions, 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce and a pinch of cayenne. Chill 30 minutes until firm. Toast 100g pecans in a dry pan for 4 minutes and chop finely. Roll the mix into 24 small balls and coat in the pecans. Chill 1 hour, push a toothpick into each and line them up in neat rows.

Prawns poached and iced, piled on crushed ice with cocktail sauce and lemon, buffet style.
M: maple syrup on the table before the pancakes
Buttermilk batter rested 15 minutes, cooked in butter until bubbles set, stacked. The maple syrup goes on the table first. Non-negotiable.
Vegas sirloin with loaded baked potato
the high-roller night in Vegas after the card counting

Thick sirloin seared hard and finished with garlic butter, a jacket potato loaded with sour cream, bacon, cheddar and chives, and creamed spinach. Rub 4 potatoes with oil and salt and bake at 200C for 60 minutes. Fry 150g diced bacon until crisp. Wilt 250g spinach, squeeze dry and stir into 150ml cream simmered with garlic and nutmeg. Season 4 sirloin steaks and sear in a smoking pan 3 minutes a side, add 40g butter and 2 crushed garlic cloves and baste for 1 minute. Rest 5 minutes. Split the potatoes and load with sour cream, bacon, cheddar and chives.
W: Fresh strawberry jelly with vanilla cream
Raymond's routine, the same dessert done the same way

Ruby jelly set from real strawberry purée, layered in glasses with sliced strawberries and topped with vanilla bean cream and a crumble of shortbread. Blend 500g hulled strawberries with 100g caster sugar and the juice of 1 lemon, then strain. Soak 4 gelatine leaves in cold water for 5 minutes, squeeze and dissolve in 150ml of the purée warmed in a pan. Stir into the rest of the purée and pour into 4 glasses over a few sliced strawberries. Chill 4 hours. Whip 200ml cream with 1 tsp vanilla paste and 1 tbsp icing sugar, spoon on and crumble 2 shortbread fingers over.
K: the maple syrup goes on the table before the pancakes

Bourbon shaken hard with real maple syrup, lemon and mint, poured over crushed ice and finished with a slice of apple. Put 8 mint leaves, 15ml maple syrup and 20ml lemon juice in a shaker for each drink and press gently with a muddler. Add 50ml bourbon and a scoop of ice and shake hard for 10 seconds. Strain into 4 rocks glasses packed with crushed ice. Garnish with a mint sprig and a thin apple slice. Totals are 200ml bourbon, 60ml maple syrup and 80ml lemon juice.

s.how: Poach 500g green prawns in salted water for 2 minutes, plunge into iced water and peel. Mix 125ml tomato sauce with 1 tbsp horseradish and lemon juice. Pile on crushed ice with the sauce and lemon wedges, buffet style.

m.how: Put the maple syrup on the table before anything else. Whisk 300g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 2 tbsp sugar, 500ml buttermilk and 2 eggs and rest 15 minutes. Cook in butter until bubbles set and stack high.
